title: A changed address without a forwarding line
body: The postcard’s address is written over in pencil; the map’s route reaches only the old street. The stamp is clean, but the new address has been rubbed thin.
rival_reading: A farm program could move its deliveries when access changed, leaving an old route on the map; the overwritten address does not prove an evacuation was mismanaged.
gloss: A postcard’s overwritten destination conflicts with the route shown on its accompanying map.

title: The leaf pressed against the growing column
body: A dry leaf is pressed into a newspaper gardening column. The notebook beneath it has the same outline drawn in the margin, but the page is turned to winter planting.
rival_reading: Someone documenting emergency conditions could preserve a leaf beside an outdated gardening page; the seasonal mismatch does not show a program malfunction.
gloss: A preserved leaf and its sketch sit beside gardening advice for a different season.
